upstream_code_changes: None. The JavaScript LocomotorSim and SixLegDynamics modules are unmodified. Our loop, UI and Python transfer adapter are separate.
anatomy: MaleCNS v1.0; 1045 selected neurons, 17224 directed edges, 708689 anatomical contacts. See vendor/LOCOMOTOR_PROVENANCE.md for omitted inputs.
geometry: Segment lengths and attachment locations match the upstream fly body. The new visual mesh is illustrative. All rendered leg endpoints are computed from the mechanical joint state.
physiology: Upstream normalized synaptic input, 1 ms LIF steps with adaptation, pooled sensory encoders and saturating motor rates. No biological calibration is claimed.
runtime: Browser worker: 120 Hz feedback, 1 kHz neurons, 600 Hz simplified mechanics. No server neural state is advanced.
mujoco_transfer: Separate four-second left-front-tibia assay. A Python port, checked against upstream JS neural states, drives two FlyMimic muscles with fixed gain 0.2. Only the physical LF knee supplies feedback. No six-leg MuJoCo walking is claimed.
claw_mapping: 815843, 817680, 912317 and 935383 are present but their joint/direction fields remain null. No assignment sweep candidate was promoted.
